definition: Formula-level expression for the quenching side of sakkāya understood through the five clung-to heaps.
notes: Use this phrase when the text explicitly treats appropriated identity in terms of nirodha. The formula inherits the technical sakkāya default identity and the repository's governed nirodha preference for quenching. Do not flatten the line into destruction-of-self rhetoric.

context_rules.context: In direct doctrinal translation of the formula
In explanatory prose where a fuller phrase is needed
context_rules.notes: Use this in explanatory prose only for clarification.

example_phrases.notes: Shows the formula line tied to the five clung-to heaps by the governing sakkāya entry.

translation_policy.default_scope: Use this as the standard wording for the quenching side of the governed sakkāya arising-and-quenching pair, where identity is treated through the five clung-to heaps.
translation_policy.when_not_to_apply: Do not use this wording where nirodha governs a subject other than appropriated identity, and do not rewrite the line as the destruction or annihilation of a self.
translation_policy.drift_risk: Prevents nirodha from sliding out of the governed quenching default and sakkāya from sliding into self-language, which together would turn a structural claim into an annihilationist one.
